manifest.matching: exact content_sha256; explicit str.strip only when full model inputs are identical

tokenizer.fields: all tokenizer fields and same-batch padded fields must match

recipe.encoding_reuse_rule: exact encoder fingerprint and target content SHA256 lookup; cache attests exact content or verified strip model-input equivalence; current canonical token IDs
recipe.index_batch_order: ascending untruncated passage token length, then unit_id
